Welcome to another enlightening episode of *Upanishad Ganga*! In this episode, we continue our exploration of the *Shodasha Samskara* – the sixteen sacred milestones that mark a person's journey through life according to the Vedic tradition. This episode, the third part of our series on *Shodasha Samskara*, delves into some of the most significant rituals and traditions that shape an individual's spiritual and worldly responsibilities.
